Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing impact fees on manufactured housing communities.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to imposing impact fees on manufactured housingcommunities; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The legislature declares that counties,cities, and towns must ensure that impact fees imposed for newdevelopment of manufactured housing communities do not exceed theproportionate share of costs reasonably related to their impact asrequired in RCW 82.02.050. The legislature recognizes the difficultyof determining development costs for different types of housing andwants to ensure manufactured housing communities pay fair impact feesas affordable housing. (2) The staffs of the senate committee on labor, commerce, andfinancial institutions and the house of representatives committee onlocal government and housing shall study the manner in which localgovernments impose impact fees on manufactured housing communitiescompared to other residential development. The study shall be p. 1 SB 5371completed no later than January 2004.
